found.description: True if this text is a financial statement containing numbers.

statement.description: Which statement the text actually is, judged from its title and content.

scale.description: The multiplier stated in the header. Null if none is stated.

columns.description: One entry per printed column, in printed order, left to right. Includes every repeated period block.

h.description: The column heading verbatim, as printed. Empty string if the column has no heading.

end.description: The date the column ends, YYYY-MM-DD, read off the heading. Null if the heading gives no date.

months.description: Months the column covers, from the heading. Null for a balance sheet instant or when the heading names no span.

rows.description: One entry per printed row of the statement, in printed order.

n.description: The row's position in the statement, counting every printed row from 1, including section headings and rows with no numbers.

v.description: This row's numbers, one per column, same length as columns. Null for a blank cell.

x.description: True if this row's numbers are NOT in the statement's scale (per-share amounts, share counts, par value, ratios, percentages). False for ordinary dollar rows.

u.description: True if the row printed FEWER numbers than there are columns, so which column each one belongs to cannot be read off the page. The numbers were placed left to right as a default and the placement is unverified. False whenever the count matches the number of columns, and false for a row with no numbers at all.
